text:
Maya: Quick sync — pricing page experiments: we need to finalize FAQ copy, pick final tier names, and lock the calculator UX. Also thinking about webinar gating + inbound routing for high-intent leads. Can we align on priorities by EOD?

Sam: +1. For tier names I still prefer clear functional names over clever ones. Proposal A: Starter / Scale / Enterprise. Proposal B: Core / Pro / Enterprise. Which resonates? :thinking_face:

Leo: From product side, whatever names we pick we should tie to concrete limits/benefits in the tooltips. Also want to update the benchmark box — show 99p latency + $/1k tokens for each tier so customers can compare economics side-by-side.

Anika: For webinars — recommend a gated signup that creates a lead in Salesforce with a "pricing_interest" hidden field (calc slider > $1k/month -> route to AE). That helped us capture intent before. Happy to own routing rules. :handshake:

Priya: Calculator UX note: prefer slider + breakdown rows (tokens/day, concurrency, estimated cost). Suggest formula in case folks want to check: `est_cost = (tokens_per_request * avg_requests_per_day * price_per_1k_tokens) / 1000`. We can show rounded monthly estimate + per-1000 token cost.

Sam: Love the formula. For A/B test we can vary whether we show monthly estimate or per-call estimate as the primary number. Hypothesis: monthly estimate drives higher signups for startups.

Beth: Timeline check — copy freeze by Tue, front-end build Wed/Thu, QA Friday. Marketing launch post + webinar invite scheduled Mon next week. Need final headline and FAQ bullets by tomorrow so design can mock.

Maya: Copy items I need: 3 headline variants, final tier names, 6 FAQ bulbs (short), and calculator labels. Can people drop suggestions here by 3pm?

Leo: Dropping quick FAQ drafts: 1) "How do you price tokens?" -> short answer + link to docs. 2) "Can I bring my model?" -> yes, explain Dedicated/Private options. 3) "What uptime SLA do you offer?" -> summarize. Will post full list in a follow-up thread.

Anika: For inbound routing — I'll add rule: if slider_estimated_monthly >= 1000 AND company_email != gmail -> assign to AE queue, else nurture track. Will test with sample leads.

Priya: Tiny copy tweak for calculator: change "Estimated monthly" -> "Estimated monthly spend" to reduce ambiguity.

Maya: :thumbsup: Ok. OpsBot can someone add calendar invite for launch review Fri 10am?

OpsBot: Calendar event created: "Pricing Launch Review" Fri 10:00 — invites: Maya, Sam, Leo, Anika, Priya, Beth.

Beth: I'll consolidate copy suggestions and post a single doc link here after 2pm.

Sam: I'll set up the A/B test flags for the calculator variants and create the experiment tracking ticket.

Maya: Great — thanks all. If anyone hits a blocker, ping me directly. :rocket:
